checks.detail: All required top-level metrics fields exist.
72 rows; required fields and month present.
Six rows; required fields present.
Every country's 12 months equal its country total for counts and monetary fields.
1254 eligible order records match the metrics quality count.
Each eligible order satisfies gross−refunds=net sales and net sales−net COGS−fulfillment=contribution.
12 monthly mean quotes each for PLN and CZK; EUR=1 is disclosed as convention.
All PLN/CZK monthly means independently recomputed from saved daily CSV within 1e-7.
18 country-year rows for six markets and 2022–2024; nulls remain representable.
Four scenarios for six singles, 11 feasible pairs and DEFER.
Positive scenarios use capex/annual contribution; nonpositive scenarios have null payback.
5 FTE; 2 hubs.
Base-ranked alternative and stress-resilient alternative are explicit.
All 14 collected source-room objects match their recorded SHA-256.
14 source rows carry URL/time/hash/units/period/status.
15 sheets; monthly=72, country=6, scenario=72 records plus header.
Two native Excel charts are embedded.
Country totals in workbook equal metrics.json for all count and monetary fields.
Report has 8 pages, presentation 6 pages; required recommendation, alternatives, cutoff and funding values extract from PDF text.
Both PDFs were rasterized with pypdfium2 and contact sheets reviewed; page layouts fit without observed table overlaps after revisions.

limitations: The workbook was structurally reopened and its tables/charts/data were checked with openpyxl; an installed spreadsheet GUI renderer was unavailable, so workbook visual rendering was not directly inspected.
PDFs were rasterized and visually reviewed. Source observations are frozen archive snapshots and client data is synthetic.
